suppress.notes: ehcache 1.6.0 (net.sf.ehcache): depot 1.8's single-JVM L2 cache. Not exposed to the network (no RMICacheManagerPeerListener / distributed replication), and ehcache.xml is a trusted local file. EOL, but 2.x is an API-incompatible major jump against depot 1.8; tracked for a coordinated bump with a depot compatibility check. Accept-risk in the interim.
jorbis 0.0.17 (org.jcraft): decodes only local, shipped Ogg game audio — never attacker-supplied streams. No notable CVE; suppressed defensively as accept-risk.
